embed.title: !incident
embed.description: Alerts for pokestop incidents: Team Rocket grunts and leaders, Giovanni, Kecleon, Pokemon Showcases and gold stops. `{{prefix}}invasion` is the same command.

fields.name: Team Rocket grunts
fields.value:
`{{prefix}}incident dragon` — grunts of one type (any pokemon type: `fire`, `water`, `steel`, ...)
`{{prefix}}incident fire ice electric` — several types
`{{prefix}}incident mixed` — the grunt with no type
`{{prefix}}incident darkness` / `decoy` / `gruntb` — other grunt kinds
`{{prefix}}incident everything` — every incident

fields.name: Other incidents
fields.value:
`{{prefix}}incident kecleon`
`{{prefix}}incident showcase` — Pokemon Showcase
`{{prefix}}incident gold-stop` — gold pokestops (also `gold_coins`)

fields.name: Grunt gender
fields.value: `{{prefix}}incident dragon female` — add `male` or `female` to only match that grunt gender

fields.name: Where
fields.value:
With neither `d:` nor `area:`, your `{{prefix}}area` list is used (unless your admin set a default distance).
`d:500` — within that many metres of your location
`location:home d:500` — measured from a saved location (`{{prefix}}help location`)
`area:city_centre` — only these areas instead of your list; several: `area:north,south`. Can't be combined with `d:`

fields.name: Options
Remove
fields.value:
`{{prefix}}incident remove dragon`
`{{prefix}}incident remove kecleon`
`{{prefix}}incident remove everything`
`{{prefix}}incident remove id:12` — one rule; `{{prefix}}tracked` shows the ids
